Class LobbyState

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.am23.network.LobbyState
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class LobbyState extends Object implements Serializable
Serializable snapshot of a lobby. Holds the lobby identity, the owner and the connected players. Shipped to clients to drive the lobby UI.
